decision.text: Built on the already-leased worktree qf-2 (branch worktree/qf-2, server 127.0.0.1:51762) instead of `worktree-up.mjs nav-links`: a pool worktree was already mine and a second worktree costs a server; alternative was worktree/nav-links as the brief says. Real branch to merge: worktree/qf-2.

/framework/ai/sessions/v/review/ does not exist in any tree yet (the review-page task is still building it), so there is nothing to link; NavCheck will refuse that page's merge until its parent links it. /framework/ai/review/ (the existing review page) is linked from the AI dashboard.

One shared PageNav pill row (ai/AIDashboard/PageNav.js) instead of ad hoc links per page, so the Merge pill and its waiting count are one component on every surface; alternative was a small link per page as before.
